title: 市场传延迟：黄仁勋却说已投产，谁会信？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We also have heard from a video founder, Jensen Huang, saying that his company's next generation, the AI Accelerator Systems, are in production and on track for delivery to customers.
segments.zh: 我们还从视频创始人黄仁勋那里听到，他公司的下一代AI加速器系统已投产，并有望按时交付客户。

segments.en: He was responding to reports that manufacturing snacks may delay its rollout.
segments.zh: 他是在回应有关制造问题可能推迟其发布的报道。

segments.en: Are you still on track? Yeah, we're on track. Completely on track, not true.
segments.zh: 你们还在按计划进行吗？是的，完全按计划，不属实。

segments.en: Okay, so Tara has the chip supply. Yeah, Vera Rubin is already in production.
segments.zh: 好的，所以Tara有芯片供应。是的，Vera Rubin已经投产。

segments.en: Okay. Yeah, giant amounts of production coming.
segments.zh: 好的，大量生产即将到来。

segments.en: Jensen Huang speaking there during a visit to Japan to talk about how in video might aid the country's sovereign and physical AI ambitions.
segments.zh: 黄仁勋在访问日本期间谈到，英伟达如何助力该国的主权和物理AI愿景。

segments.en: For more let's bring in senior tech editor Nick Turner and Nick, we saw the market reaction with the tech selloff when we got the semi-analysis report earlier this month. How much is at stake
segments.zh: 更多内容，请连线资深科技编辑Nick Turner。Nick，我们看到本月早些时候半导体分析报告发布后，市场出现科技股抛售。Vera Rubin的成败有多重要？

segments.en: when it comes to the Vera Rubin? Yeah, well this is obviously their flagship product.
segments.zh: 是的，这显然是他们的旗舰产品。

segments.en: This is the latest generation. It's supposed to start being delivered essentially this quarter and ramping up production in the fourth quarter. So everybody's really in kind of this weight and
segments.zh: 这是最新一代产品，预计本季度开始交付，第四季度量产。所以大家都在观望，看生产是否如预期顺利。

segments.en: sea mode to see whether a production goes as smoothly as everyone hopes and any signs that maybe things aren't going smoothly are really sort of elevated and people scrutinize it. Obviously what the CEO
segments.zh: 任何不顺利的迹象都会被放大并受到审视。显然，CEO的言论至关重要。

segments.en: said today was things seem to be fine. Volume is going to be big and we're doing great. So that's kind of the latest news on this. How consequential is it for the rest of the industry?
segments.zh: 今天他表示一切似乎进展顺利，出货量会很大，我们表现很好。这就是最新情况。这对行业其他部分影响有多大？
